transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... my family and friends keep saying these bank papers prove nothing was taken from me. But I know what's going on. For over a year now, I’ve known they’re hiding my money. They just use things to cover it up—like bills, or these fundraisers, and plans for trips. It's all a cover. So I have to keep confronting them. I just have to keep at it until they finally tell the truth.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people around you could not hear or see?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I mean, my eyes and ears work just fine. I'm not making things up in my head, I just see the real things they do to hide my money.
Do you have any other strong beliefs that people are trying to harm you, spy on you, or otherwise deceive you?

No, it's really just the money. I don't think anyone is spying on me or trying to physically hurt me. It's just... I already told you about the money. My family and my friends, they keep showing me these bank papers, trying to say nothing was taken. But I know they are hiding it. It's been over a year of this. They use all these regular things to cover it up—like paying bills, or these fundraisers they talk about, or making plans for trips. It's all just a way to hide that they took it. That's why I just keep confronting them. I'm not going to stop until they finally admit the truth about my money.
Has this belief about your money been affecting your work, school, or daily life?

Well, I don't have a job or go to school right now, but... yeah, it does affect my everyday life. I mean, since I have to keep bringing up the money, people are just pulling away from me. Like my relatives, they just avoid helping me with my bills now. And my friends... they've completely stopped including me in those fundraisers or any of the travel plans they make. They just leave me out of it all because I won't stop asking them for the truth.
During the times you’ve been most upset about the money, have you also felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I don't... I mean, I sleep just normal. I haven't noticed anything like having too much energy or not needing to sleep. I just get really mad about what they're doing with my money, but my energy and how much I sleep are just regular.
Have you ever had this same kind of belief about something else besides your money?

No, I haven't. It's... it's really just the money. I don't have any other things like that going on. I mean, I've never had a reason to think people were doing this with anything else. It's just this one thing, because it's what they actually did to me. So, no, nothing besides the money.
Have you ever had a time when your mood was very depressed?

No, I haven't. I mean... I get angry and frustrated about what they're doing with my money, sure. But I wouldn't say I've ever been depressed. My mood is mostly fine, I just... I just want what belongs to me. So, no, I haven't had a time where I was really down or depressed like that.
Have you ever felt unusually suspicious that your family or friends were poisoning your food or drink?

No, I... no, definitely not. I've never thought anything like that. My family and friends wouldn't do that, and I've never worried about my food or drink. It's just the money. That's the only thing they're messing with.
Do you have any actual proof that the money was taken, or is it possible that nothing was taken?

I know what they say. I came in here because my family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken. They wave these statements in my face, but... but I know. For over a year now, I've known they're hiding my money. They use things like bills, or these fundraisers they talk about, or plans for trips to cover it up. They think I don't see what they're doing. It's not possible that nothing was taken. I know it was. So I just have to keep confronting them about it until they finally tell the truth.
Do you believe that one of the people involved is not really who they say they are?

No, I don't think that. They're my family and my friends... I know exactly who they are. Nobody is pretending to be someone else or anything weird like that. I know it's them. Like I said, the only issue is what they're doing behind my back with the money. But no, they are definitely who they say they are.
Have you ever had a period of several days or more when you felt unusually happy or irritable and much more active than usual?

No, I haven't. I mean, I don't think I've ever felt like that. Just... normal, I guess, except for being upset about what they're doing with my money. But no weird happy spells or anything like you're asking about.
